explication: RTranslator is an Android app for offline text and speech translation. Its main conversation workflow captures speech, recognizes it, sends recognized text to connected peers, translates incoming text, and speaks the translation; WalkieTalkie performs turn-based recognition and translation on one phone, while text translation provides a separate text-first mode. The README also documents model selection and downloads. The graph combines those documented capabilities with sampled service and download behavior; unsampled implementation details are represented only at supported directory paths.
